startupWallBoundary: Harness time from before MCP request through observing native snapshot diagnostics; includes MCP, UI, IPC and polling latency.
nativeBoundary: firstAudioMs and seekFirstAudioMs are copied from native snapshot diagnostics; these exclude renderer/MCP wall latency.
limitations: This driver uses MCP tool calls and does not click the UI or claim codec identity.
The MCP playback tools do not accept caller operation IDs; harnessOperationId identifies each attempt, while native IDs are captured only when exposed in diagnostics.
Output is allowlisted metrics and fixed failure categories; source URLs, local paths, credentials, and stderr are omitted.
